name: guardrail
description: Redacts secrets before Claude reads them, keeps confidential and personal data away from Codex, holds sends/deploys/orders/destructive commands for your yes, and refuses to commit secrets.

confidentialTerms.title: Confidential terms
confidentialTerms.description: Client names and other terms that must never reach Codex, comma-separated.

extraSecretPatterns.title: Extra secret patterns
extraSecretPatterns.description: Regexes for secrets the built-in shapes miss, comma- or newline-separated.

extraNeverCommit.title: Extra never-commit paths
extraNeverCommit.description: Regexes for paths that must never be committed, comma-separated.

holdTools.title: Also hold these tools
holdTools.description: Regexes for tool names to hold, comma-separated.

allowTools.title: Never hold these tools
allowTools.description: Regexes for connector tools never to hold, comma-separated.

scanPii.title: Scan Codex calls for personal data
scanPii.description: Emails, Israeli phone numbers and card numbers.

redactTranscript.title: Redact secrets from what Claude reads
redactTranscript.description: Replaces secrets with placeholders; local tools get the real values back.
